Immediately after constructing the actual Trainer, v3 observes the constructor thread count and reapplies intraop_threads=1 before setup_model/actual train. It asserts actual intraop_threads=1 and interop_threads=1 after that reset, on_train_start, at each optimizer_step, before capture/save, and in the final receipt. Runtime backend flags are recorded at after-constructor reset, train start, pre-capture save entry and final receipt.
